track.title: Homayun: Abolchap
track.notes: Open: no played pitch within 60 ¢ of the suite's finalis G (186.0 Hz); the vote picked the 4th.

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on B3 and dwells most on B in Abolchap. The line peaks at C#4 (279.6 Hz) at 0:30.7. It closes on the tonic (A#3 → B3 → B3 → C#4 → B3 → B3).
